                    result[r][c] = grid[next_r][ic] if grid[next_r][ic] > 0 else val
                elif dr == 0 and dc % 2 == 1:
                    next_c = (ic + 1) % w
                    result[r][c] = grid[ir][next_c] if grid[ir][next_c] > 0 else val
    
    return result
